scripts.dev:fresh: npm run dev:stop && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/start-dev-services.ps1
scripts.dev:services: set "MCP_PUBLIC_RESOURCE_URL=%npm_package_config_mcp_public_resource_url%" && set "MCP_AUTH0_CLIENT_ID=%npm_package_config_mcp_auth0_client_id%" && set "MCP_AUTH0_REQUIRED_SCOPE=%npm_package_config_mcp_auth0_required_scope%" && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --success all --names card-runtime,backend,dependents --prefix-colors yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev:card-runtime" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:after-backend"
scripts.dev:dependent-services: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --success all --names frontend,python-rails,knowgraph,mcp,tunnel,worldview --prefix-colors green,cyan,blue,white,gray,magenta "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/start-dependent-services.ps1 -StartFrontendAfterApplicationReadiness" "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/start-dependent-services.ps1 -StartPythonRailsAfterWorldSignals" "npm run dev:knowgraph" "npm run dev:mcp" "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/start-dependent-services.ps1 -WaitForMcpReadiness" "npm run dev:worldview"
scripts.dev:card-runtime: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const root=path.join(process.cwd(),'HermesLatest');const python=path.join(root,'.venv','Scripts','python.exe');const profileRoot=path.join(root,'.hermes');const token=String(process.env.HERMES_DASHBOARD_SESSION_TOKEN||'');const validToken=token.length===64&&[...token.toLowerCase()].every(c=>'0123456789abcdef'.includes(c));if(!fs.existsSync(python))throw new Error('Card runtime Python executable is unavailable.');if(!fs.existsSync(path.join(profileRoot,'config.yaml')))throw new Error('Card runtime default profile is unavailable.');if(!validToken)throw new Error('Card runtime credential is unavailable.');const child=spawnSync(python,['-m','hermes_cli.main','-p','default','serve','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','9119','--skip-build'],{cwd:root,env:{...process.env,HERMES_HOME:profileRoot,PYTHONUTF8:'1',PYTHONIOENCODING:'utf-8'},stdio:'inherit',windowsHide:true});if(child.error)throw child.error;process.exit(child.status??1);"
scripts.dev:mcp: set "MCP_TRANSPORT=streamable-http" && set "MCP_HTTP_PORT=8765" && set "MCP_PUBLIC_RESOURCE_URL=%npm_package_config_mcp_public_resource_url%" && set "MCP_AUTH0_ISSUER_URL=%npm_package_config_mcp_auth0_issuer_url%" && set "MCP_AUTH0_AUDIENCE=%npm_package_config_mcp_public_resource_url%" && set "MCP_AUTH0_CLIENT_ID=%npm_package_config_mcp_auth0_client_id%" && set "MCP_AUTH0_REQUIRED_SCOPE=%npm_package_config_mcp_auth0_required_scope%" && set "MCP_OAUTH_ENFORCED=true" && apps\python-models\.venv\Scripts\python.exe apps\python-models\app\mcp_host.py
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/backend
scripts.typecheck:spec: npm run typecheck:spec --workspace client && npm run typecheck:spec --workspace apps/backend
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:spec
